plainText:
Zoey's Gastrodon (Japanese: ノゾミのトリトドン Nozomi's Tritodon) is a owned by Zoey. It appears to be one of her signature Pokémon, along with .

==History==
 
Zoey Gastrodon as a Shellos shortly after the events of Buizel Your Way Out Of This!. After failing to catch a that later caught, Zoey was revealed to have stayed in the area around the river to find another , which turned out to be Shellos.

Shellos debuted in A Stand-Up Sit-Down!, where it helped its teach about Double Performances in preparation for the . It created a stunning combination with its own attack and 's . The two later teamed up for Zoey's battle with Jessilina. Their combinations were far better than 's and 's and they won the match.

Zoey used it in the first round of the Hearthome City Pokémon Contest in Dawn's Early Night!, where it teamed up with Glameow yet again in a Double Performance. The combination of their moves impressed the Contest Judges and placed Zoey among the eight hard-working Pokémon Coordinators that advanced to the Battle Stage.

It later made a short appearance in Pruning a Passel of Pals!, beating a in the Wallace Cup allowing Zoey to move on to the next round. In Playing The Leveling Field!, it was revealed that Shellos helped win Zoey her third Ribbon.

In Last Call — First Round!, it was revealed to have evolved into a . Zoey used it in the Performance Stage of the Sinnoh Grand Festival with Lumineon where they performed with their and attacks to give a unique appeal. After making it through the round, the two Pokémon were used in Zoey's first round battle where once again they won. It was used once again in the event with Glameow to secure Zoey's place in the semifinals.

==Personality and characteristics==
As a Shellos, it was easily scared, as shown in its debut when Zoey introduced it to and . Shellos was particularly intimidated by Dawn's Buizel due to the way Buizel approached it. When performing, however, Shellos displays its confidence, showcasing its moves and skills in impressive ways.

It appears to be Zoey's second most used Pokémon in a similar way to Nando's Kricketune, even being stated by in Double-Time Battle Training! that it is one of her most reliable Pokémon.
